record.question: In clinical practice, for xray attenuation:
options: the first and second HVL [half value layer] are equal
the first HVL is greater than second HVL
the second HVL is greater than first HVL
the first and second HVL are inversely proportional
record.explanation: Answer C: the second HVL is greater than first HVL. Beam hardening makes the second half-value layer greater than the first. Reference: https://www.nist.gov/pml/periodic-table-elements; https://aerb.gov.in/english/radiation-protection-principle. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
